papers.title: Budgeted Subset Selection with a Transferable Learned Value Model
papers.translated_title: 带可迁移学习价值模型的预算子集选择
papers.author: Jade Lejeune Herman
papers.summary: Subset selection is a fundamental task in machine learning, statistics and combinatorial optimisation, with applications in active learning, band selection, input selection and experimental design. The utility of a subset depends on information revealed only after the selection, such as labels or responses, and on interactions among selected candidates. Existing approaches combine value estimation and redundancy control in application-specific ways, which limits their use in other domains. This paper introduces Subset Acquisition with Learned Value Estimates and Search (SALVES), a framework that decomposes subset selection into two components. First, a value model is trained by supervised learning on tasks where the hidden information is known. On a new task, it predicts the utility each candidate would add to the current selection. Second, a selection step chooses the subset from these predictions, typically by simulated annealing with a diversity term penalising redundancy. The value model transfers to new classes, pretrained networks, datasets and sensors, and from synthetic to real data. On the four applications, SALVES matches or outperforms application-specific baselines on average. It requires substantially fewer bands for equal accuracy and remains reliable in input selection where individual baselines fail.
papers.translated_summary: 子集选择是机器学习、统计学和组合优化中的一项基础任务，其应用涵盖主动学习、波段选择、输入选择和实验设计。一个子集的效用取决于仅在选择之后才揭示的信息（如标签或响应），以及所选候选之间的交互作用。现有方法以特定于应用的方式将价值估计与冗余控制相结合，这限制了它们在其他领域中的使用。本文提出了一种名为“基于学习价值估计与搜索的子集获取”（SALVES）的框架，该框架将子集选择分解为两个组成部分。首先，在隐藏信息已知的任务上通过监督学习训练一个价值模型。在新任务上，该模型预测每个候选将为当前选择增加的效用。其次，一个选择步骤根据这些预测来选取子集，通常采用模拟退火并辅以惩罚冗余的多样性项。该价值模型可迁移至新类别、预训练网络、数据集和传感器，并可从合成数据迁移至真实数据。在四个应用中，SALVES平均而言达到或超过了特定于应用的基线方法。在达到同等精度的情况下，它所需的波段数量大幅减少，并且在单个基线方法失效的输入选择场景中仍保持可靠性。

papers.title: RoSci: Exploring Robustness in Science VLMs
papers.translated_title: RoSci：探索科学视觉语言模型的鲁棒性
papers.author: Junying Wang
papers.summary: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable significant progress in scientific tasks. However, these models are generally assumed to be presented with complete and accurate information, overlooking the challenges of erroneous/missing information in wild scenarios. To address this gap, we introduce the concept of Scientific Model Robustness, which defines a model's ability to detect anomalies, assess solvability, and perform self-calibration when faced with Information Error (inconsistencies) or Information Loss (insufficiency). Specifically, we present RoSci-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,220 samples using a seed-variant strategy across six degradation types. To address VLM fragility, we further propose RoSci-Agent, a framework that employs a Parse-Verify-Decide pipeline to vet premises before reasoning. The evaluated VLMs sometimes answer questions whose premises are invalid or incomplete. RoSci-Agent achieves a higher Overall Robustness Score than the evaluated standalone VLMs. RoSci-Bench gives the multimodal reasoning community a common test of when models answer, request clarification, or reject a scientific question.
papers.translated_summary: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）的最新进展推动了科学任务的显著进步。然而，这些模型通常被假设为面对完整且准确的信息，忽视了野外场景中错误/缺失信息带来的挑战。为填补这一空白，我们引入了科学模型鲁棒性的概念，其定义模型在面对信息错误（不一致性）或信息丢失（不充分性）时检测异常、评估可解性并执行自校准的能力。具体而言，我们提出了RoSci-Bench，一个包含1，220个样本的诊断基准，采用种子-变体策略覆盖六种退化类型。为解决VLM的脆弱性，我们进一步提出了RoSci-Agent，一个采用解析-验证-决策流水线在推理前审查前提的框架。被评估的VLMs有时会回答前提无效或不完整的问题。RoSci-Agent取得了比被评估的独立VLMs更高的整体鲁棒性得分。RoSci-Bench为多模态推理社区提供了一个共同的测试，用于判断模型何时回答、请求澄清或拒绝一个科学问题。

papers.title: Shared Understanding in Human-AI Teams: Coordination Continuity in Evolving Work
papers.translated_title: 人类-人工智能团队中的共享理解：演化工作里的协调连续性
papers.author: Siân Lindley
papers.summary: People are increasingly working with AI agents as part of extended, asynchronous workflows. In these settings, shared access to information does not guarantee a shared basis for action: goals, plans, and roles may persist while their current significance changes. We introduce coordination continuity, the extent to which collaborators sustain a workable basis for interdependent action as work progresses. Drawing on research on collaborative work, along with two qualitative team studies and a reflexive case from our own repository-based environment, we present a framework of three elements: durable representations of collaborative work; relative coordination properties that support interpretation of representations in the moment; and interaction mechanisms through which the status of representations can be understood and altered. We use a build-act-drift-rebuild heuristic and the notion of consequential moments to characterise when rebuilding may be needed. We draw eight design implications for collaborative AI infrastructure.
papers.translated_summary: 人们越来越多地将AI代理作为扩展的异步工作流的一部分来协同工作。在这些情境中，对信息的共享访问并不保证共享的行动基础：目标、计划和角色可能持续存在，但其当前意义会发生变化。我们引入协调连续性这一概念，即协作者在工作推进过程中维持可用的相互依赖行动基础的程度。基于对协作工作的研究，以及两项定性团队研究和来自我们自己基于仓库环境的反思性案例，我们提出了一个包含三个要素的框架：协作工作的持久表征；支持在当下解释表征的相对协调属性；以及能够理解和改变表征状态的交互机制。我们使用“构建—行动—漂移—重建”的启发式方法和“后果性时刻”的概念来描述何时可能需要重建。我们提出了对协作式AI基础设施的八项设计启示。

papers.title: Can Vision-Language Models Synthesize Executable Game-Playing Programs?
papers.translated_title: 视觉语言模型能合成可执行的游戏程序吗？
papers.author: Yao Tong
papers.summary: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have endowed multimodal agents with increasingly strong visual perception and long-horizon reasoning capabilities, making VLM-based autonomous game playing feasible. Existing game benchmarks primarily evaluate whether an agent can select appropriate actions from the current visual state across different scenarios and games. However, most of them adopt a step-by-step interaction paradigm where the current visual observation is sent to the agent before each action. In practical deployment, this paradigm introduces two fundamental limitations: the game loop must wait for model inference, making real-time interaction impractical, and repeated VLM calls incur substantial cost. Therefore, we propose PlayScriptBench, a script-based game benchmark that evaluates whether VLMs can synthesize an executable game-playing program from game states. This setting jointly evaluates visual grounding, understanding of game dynamics, long-horizon strategic reasoning, and executable program synthesis, providing a more comprehensive assessment of game-playing agents. To support more tractable evaluation for current general-purpose VLMs, we further introduce a four-stage pipeline --- Explore, Perception, API Construction, and Strategy Composition --- that decomposes controller synthesis into game exploration, state perception, interface construction, and strategic control, enabling agents to progressively construct an executable program. Experiments on 16 games spanning 4 genres show that even strong VLMs struggle on our benchmark, revealing a substantial gap between passive visual game understanding and executable closed-loop game control. These results establish script-based controller synthesis as a complementary direction for benchmarking VLM-based game-playing agents.
papers.translated_summary: 近期视觉语言模型（VLM）的进展使多模态智能体具备了日益强大的视觉感知与长程推理能力，使得基于VLM的自主游戏游玩成为可行。现有的游戏基准主要评估智能体能否在不同场景和游戏中根据当前视觉状态选择合适动作。然而，大多数基准采用逐步交互范式，即在每次动作前将当前视觉观察发送给智能体。在实际部署中，该范式带来两个根本性局限：游戏循环必须等待模型推理，使实时交互不切实际；重复调用VLM产生高昂成本。因此，我们提出PlayScriptBench，一个基于脚本的游戏基准，评估VLM能否从游戏状态合成可执行的游戏游玩程序。该设定联合评估视觉 grounding、对游戏动态的理解、长程战略推理以及可执行程序合成，为游戏游玩智能体提供更全面的评估。为支持对当前通用VLM进行更可处理的评估，我们进一步引入四阶段流水线——探索、感知、API构建与策略组合——将控制器合成分解为游戏探索、状态感知、接口构建与战略控制，使智能体能够逐步构建可执行程序。在涵盖4个类别的16款游戏上的实验表明，即使强大的VLM在我们的基准上也表现不佳，揭示了被动视觉游戏理解与可执行闭环游戏控制之间的显著差距。这些结果确立了基于脚本的控制器合成作为评估基于VLM的游戏游玩智能体的一个互补方向。

papers.title: Average-Depth Variable Execution via Request-Local Token Routing
papers.translated_title: 通过请求本地令牌路由实现的平均深度可变执行
papers.author: Pengjie Zheng
papers.summary: Layer skipping can reduce large language model inference costs, but a request budget does not specify how to allocate layer execution across generated tokens. We introduce \method{}, which allows tokens to execute different numbers of layers while matching each request's mean executed depth to a continuous budget. At each routed layer, a router reads the current token state and its request's budget and decides whether to execute the Transformer block. Tokens that skip the block pass through a lightweight residual adapter and write no key/value (K/V) entry at that layer. A single checkpoint serves requests with different budgets in the same batch. Across three LLaMA backbones, six quality metrics, and 13 budgets, AVERT is best or tied for best in 206 of 234 comparisons. Across single- and mixed-budget batches, the mean absolute per-request budget error is at most 1.15 percentage points. When grouping requests by budget leaves batches underfilled, mixing budgets reduces decode time per output token (TPOT) by 4.3--21.2%.
papers.translated_summary: 层跳过可以降低大语言模型的推理成本，但请求预算并未规定如何在生成的 token 之间分配层执行。我们引入 \method{}，它允许 token 执行不同数量的层，同时使每个请求的平均执行深度匹配一个连续预算。在每个路由层，路由器读取当前 token 状态及其请求的预算，并决定是否执行 Transformer 块。跳过该块的 token 通过一个轻量级残差适配器，并且在该层不写入任何键/值（K/V）条目。单个检查点可在同一批次中服务具有不同预算的请求。在三种 LLaMA 主干、六项质量指标和 13 种预算下，AVERT 在 234 次比较中有 206 次为最佳或并列最佳。在单预算和混合预算批次中，每个请求的平均绝对预算误差至多为 1.15 个百分点。当按预算对请求分组导致批次填充不足时，混合预算可将每输出 token 的解码时间（TPOT）降低 4.3--21.2%。

papers.title: AutoOntologyBench: A Task-Grounded Benchmark for Agentic Knowledge Engineering
papers.translated_title: AutoOntologyBench：面向智能体知识工程的基于任务的基准测试
papers.author: Minye Shao
papers.summary: Foundation-model agents are increasingly extending beyond software engineering (SWE) into autonomous scientific research, where acquiring and integrating domain knowledge remains a critical challenge. Recent industrial advances have increasingly adopted knowledge graphs and ontology-based semantic layers to organize heterogeneous knowledge into reusable representations. We ask: Can autonomous agents construct ontologies that help them solve real tasks, and do they offer measurable benefits over alternative knowledge representations? Existing benchmarks evaluate ontology correctness or agent task success in isolation, leaving the value of autonomously acquired knowledge unresolved. We therefore introduce AutoOntologyBench, a task-grounded benchmark comprising 19,947 audited tasks grounded in 18 real-world knowledge sources across 7 domains, with source-native verification. Spanning Application, Repair, Organization, and Construction, AutoOntologyBench compares nine frontier-model agents under matched knowledge representations. Layered on retrieval, agent-built ontologies add 6.1 points of task success, yet trail an expert-derived reference by 13.0, identifying autonomous knowledge acquisition as the bottleneck to scalable scientific research. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/VinyehShaw/AutoOntologyBench.
papers.translated_summary: 基础模型智能体正日益从软件工程扩展到自主科学研究，而在这一领域中，获取和整合领域知识仍然是一项关键挑战。近期的产业进展越来越多地采用知识图谱和基于本体的语义层，将异构知识组织为可复用的表示形式。我们提出疑问：自主智能体能否构建本体以帮助其解决真实任务，并且这些本体相较于其他知识表示形式是否能带来可衡量的收益？现有基准孤立地评估本体的正确性或智能体的任务成功率，使得自主获取知识的价值悬而未决。因此，我们推出 AutoOntologyBench，这是一个以任务为基础的基准，包含 19,947 个经审核的任务，这些任务基于 7 个领域中 18 个真实世界知识源，并采用源生验证。AutoOntologyBench 涵盖应用、修复、组织与构建，在匹配的知识表示下比较了九个前沿模型智能体。在检索之上叠加智能体构建的本体可带来 6.1 个百分点的任务成功率提升，但仍落后于专家推导的参考标准 13.0 个百分点，从而将自主知识获取确定为可扩展科学研究的瓶颈。代码与资源见 https://github.com/VinyehShaw/AutoOntologyBench。

papers.title: Do Alice and Bob Dream of the Oracle? Wishful Cryptanalysis
papers.translated_title: 爱丽丝和鲍勃会梦见神谕吗？一厢情愿的密码分析
papers.author: Guoxiao Liu
papers.summary: For two millennia, offense and defense have forged cryptographic security boundaries. Tools automated calculation and search, while humans drove discovery. Foundation models now mark a shift from automated computation to intelligent scientific discovery. Because cryptanalysis rests on exact mathematical definitions and immediately executable truth, it offers a proving ground for autonomous intelligence to move past security reliant on scarce human attention and explore structures beyond human working memory. Unguided models stall between two opposite traps: authority hallucination, where they surrender whenever prior literature declares a route blocked, and reasoning hallucination, where they produce subtle, unverifiable flaws. Closed platforms and generic agent loops further impede sustained open inquiry. We introduce wishful cryptanalysis, a harness-agnostic methodology that pairs constructive optimism against entrenched assumptions with blinded, zero-import verification against error. Agents first compress reduced-scale theory within provisioned compute so live witnesses certify their mathematics automatically. They then co-adapt primitive, algorithm, and hardware, and climb parameter ladders toward high-round theory. Applied across frontier open-weight and proprietary models with minimal human intervention beyond targets and compute, this paradigm yielded novel attack techniques and thirteen verifiable practical results across Keccak (SHA-3) and AES. These include breaking a fifteen-year-open public challenge and closing longstanding practical gaps, released alongside an early-preview open-source workbench (agent-framework). Extending Kerckhoffs's principle into the AI era, we envision an Open Oracle, an open and auditable public infrastructure that frees cryptographers to legislate security goals, challenge assumptions, distill theory, and co-design resilient standards.
papers.translated_summary: 两千年来，攻与防锻造了密码学的安全边界。工具自动化了计算与搜索，而人类驱动着发现。基础模型如今标志着从自动化计算向智能科学发现的转变。由于密码分析建立在精确的数学定义和可立即执行的真理之上，它为自主智能提供了一个试验场，使其能够超越依赖稀缺人类注意力的安全模式，并探索超出人类工作记忆的结构。无引导的模型会在两个相反的陷阱之间停滞：权威幻觉，即当先前文献宣称某条路径被阻断时便放弃；以及推理幻觉，即产生微妙且无法验证的缺陷。封闭平台和通用智能体循环进一步阻碍了持续的开放探究。我们提出“愿望式密码分析”，一种与框架无关的方法论，它将针对根深蒂固假设的建设性乐观与针对错误的盲化、零导入验证相结合。智能体首先在配置的算力内压缩缩减规模的理论，使实时见证自动证明其数学正确性。随后它们协同适配原语、算法和硬件，并沿参数阶梯攀升至高层数理论。在仅需目标和算力、极少人类干预的情况下，该范式应用于前沿开放权重和专有模型，在Keccak（SHA-3）和AES上产生了新颖的攻击技术和十三项可验证的实际结果。这些包括破解一个开放十五年的公开挑战并弥合长期存在的实际差距，同时发布了一个早期预览的开源工作台（agent-framework）。将Kerckhoffs原则延伸至AI时代，我们设想一个Open Oracle，一种开放且可审计的公共基础设施，使密码学家得以解放出来，去制定安全目标、挑战假设、提炼理论并协同设计具有韧性的标准。

papers.title: Quantitative Measurement of Pavement Distress based on Vehicle Camera and Perspective Correction
papers.translated_title: 基于车载相机与透视校正的路面病害定量测量
papers.author: Sike Wang
papers.summary: Using image data is becoming an important method for highway agencies to automatically evaluate pavement conditions. However, most studies focus on improving detection accuracy rather than obtaining quantitative measurements, such as the length or area of pavement distress. Although field camera calibration can provide such measurements, it is impractical for large volumes of onboard images collected from different vehicles. This study develops a method to quantitatively measure pavement distress directly from in-vehicle camera images without on-site camera calibration. A quadrilateral region of interest is first identified based on lane detection and used to construct a perspective transformation matrix for image correction. Size correction is then performed using the proportions of road markings in the image and a specified scale, which also enables estimation of the actual width of the selected region. The corrected images are subsequently processed using object detection algorithms to obtain quantitative distress measurements. The proposed method can efficiently perform perspective correction for images collected by the same vehicle camera with minimal manual effort. The measured pavement patch lengths show a trend consistent with pavement friction data. By calibrating vehicle cameras using only image information, this study enables quantitative pavement distress detection without additional field experiments. The approach provides a practical solution for processing large volumes of vehicle-camera data, particularly as connected vehicles generate increasing amounts of uncalibrated roadway imagery.
papers.translated_summary: 利用图像数据正成为公路管理机构自动评估路面状况的重要方法。然而，大多数研究侧重于提高检测精度，而非获得定量测量结果，例如路面病害的长度或面积。尽管现场相机标定可以提供此类测量，但对于从不同车辆采集的大量车载图像而言并不现实。本研究开发了一种无需现场相机标定、可直接从车载相机图像中定量测量路面病害的方法。首先基于车道检测识别出一个四边形感兴趣区域，并用于构建透视变换矩阵以进行图像校正。随后利用图像中道路标线的比例和指定尺度进行尺寸校正，这也使得能够估计所选区域的实际宽度。校正后的图像随后通过目标检测算法处理，以获得定量的病害测量结果。所提出的方法能够以最少的人工投入，对同一车辆相机采集的图像高效地进行透视校正。测得的路面修补长度与路面摩擦数据呈现一致的趋势。本研究仅利用图像信息对车辆相机进行标定，从而无需额外的现场实验即可实现定量路面病害检测。该方法为处理大量车载相机数据提供了实用解决方案，尤其是随着网联汽车产生越来越多未经标定的道路图像。

papers.title: A Switching Mechanism for Selecting Environment-Adaptive Personalized Gains in Hearing Aids
papers.translated_title: 一种用于在助听器中选择环境自适应个性化增益的切换机制
papers.author: Nafisa Zarrin Tasnim
papers.summary: Personalized amplification gains for hearing aids have been shown to be preferred over prescriptive gains. Since the preferred settings can vary depending on the background audio environment, this paper presents a switching mechanism or system that automatically selects personalized gains for a current background audio environment. To prevent foreground speech from interfering with background environment analysis, a one-class voice activity detector is designed to identify speech activity from speech mixed with noise. A consistency check is conducted to enable distinguishing foreground speech from background speech, preserving babble as a background environment of interest because hearing aid users often struggle to understand speech in background babble. Sound segments without foreground speech are then analyzed by an online discovery method combining Bayesian change-point detection with a memory of previously encountered environments. This discovery method detects changes, recognizes returning environments, and discovers new ones without a predefined number of environments. Experimental results show that three-seed mean macro-averaged F1 scores of 85.53%-91.98% across eight speech/background-corpus pairs covering 36 background noise types were achieved. Furthermore, the discovery method achieved adjusted Rand indices of 0.91 and 0.96 on two families of test streams. In the same-recording-return condition of audio streams combining speech with four background audio environments often encountered by hearing aid users, the switching mechanism selected the correct personalized gain profile after 105 environment changes, recalled the stored gain profile at every return, and made no switches to an incorrect gain profile.

papers.title: A Cognitive Agentic AI Framework for Interactive Process Analysis and Optimization
papers.translated_title: 面向交互式过程分析与优化的认知型智能体AI框架
papers.author: Trung Ngoc Trinha
papers.summary: Complex multivariable process analysis and optimization require coordinated access to simulation, structured data, machine learning (ML), optimization, and scientific literature, often across disconnected software tools. We present a Cognitive Agentic AI Framework (CAAF) that enables interactive, iterative process investigation through natural-language prompts within an established flowsheet. Following harness-engineering principles, CAAF assigns task interpretation, planning, knowledge synthesis, and context management to a large language model while delegating numerical calculations to specialized tools. Dedicated providers connect databases, scientific-document retrieval, ML-assisted Bayesian optimization (BO), and COCO process simulation. The framework is demonstrated on methyl acetate production. Guided by successive prompts, an engineer explored multivariable relationships, conducted 4,000 BO iterations to maximize carbon conversion yield (C-Yield) and minimize specific energy cost (C-SEC), refined operating bounds, and verified selected candidates through process simulation. Re-simulation of 16 candidates within the restricted domain showed close agreement with ML predictions, with a mean absolute C-Yield error of 0.0085 (0.85 percentage points). The highest BO-derived C-Yield, verified by COCO, was 0.921 versus approximately 0.81 in the initial dataset, an improvement of about 11 percentage points. CAAF also detects and reports non-converged simulations, excludes invalid outputs, and continues subsequent evaluations. The results demonstrate how human-guided agentic coordination can combine engineering tools for iterative analysis and optimization with rigorous simulation-based verification under a fixed process topology.

papers.title: Remarkable Biosynthetic Diversity in the Bionectriaceae: Uncovering the genomic basis of antipathogen bioactivity of cacao fungal endophytes Clonostachys rosea and Waltergamsia zeylanica.
papers.translated_title: Bionectriaceae中显著的生物合成多样性：揭示可可真菌内生菌Clonostachys rosea和Waltergamsia zeylanica抗病原生物活性的基因组基础。
papers.author: Atencio, L. A.
papers.summary: Cacao (Theobroma cacao) production in tropical countries is threatened by fungal diseases caused by Moniliophthora roreri and M. perniciosa. Two cacao pod endophytes from Bionectriaceae, Clonostachys rosea TCF417 and Waltergamsia zeylanica TCF400, exhibit growth antagonism towards M. roreri; however, the genetic basis underlying the bioactivity of these strains has not been addressed. Here, we aimed to identify biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) potentially associated with the antifungal bioactivity of these two strains and performed a comparative analysis with 30 publicly available Bionectriaceae genomes using BiG-SCAPE. Whole-genome sequencing using Oxford Nanopore and Illumina technologies, resulted in assemblies of 52.9 Mb (C. rosea TCF417) and 31 Mb (W. zeylanica TCF400). Genome annotation was conducted using Funannotate, and secondary metabolite BGCs were predicted using antiSMASH. The two cacao endophytes harbored 92 BGCs (C. rosea: 67; W. zeylanica: 25), indicating remarkable biosynthetic diversity. Across all 32 genomes, 1,523 BGC-containing regions were identified, most belonging to T1PKS clusters. Network-based clustering revealed 209 gene cluster families (GCFs), of which 52 corresponded to previously characterized BGCs. Conserved BGCs for antifungal compounds, including sorbicillinoids and verticillins, were identified in cacao endophytes and across Bionectriaceae. Additionally, an antifungal assay conducted here demonstrated that verticillin D from C. rosea TCF417 exhibited growth inhibition of plant pathogens Moniliophthora roreri and Mycena citricolor. With about 75% of unassigned GCFs, our results reveal a largely untapped biosynthetic repertoire in the Bionectriaceae and identify verticillin D as a candidate contributor to the antagonism of C. rosea against plant pathogens.

papers.title: Xist deletion in T cells protects against influenza-induced lung injury
papers.translated_title: Xist在T细胞中的缺失可防止流感诱导的肺损伤
papers.author: Valero-Pacheco, N.
papers.summary: Sex differences in antiviral immunity are well established, yet the contribution of X-Chromosome Inactivation (XCI) to T cell responses during infection is unknown. Here, we identify an unexpected role for Xist RNA in shaping T cell immunity and pulmonary injury following influenza infection. We show that the inactive X chromosome (Xi) in pulmonary CD4+ and CD8+ T cells undergoes dynamic epigenetic remodeling, with limited Xist RNA localization, differential enrichment of H3K27me3 and H2AK119Ub modifications, and activation-dependent XCI escape of immune-related genes, including Il2rg and Cxcr3. Remarkably, T cell-specific Xist deletion protects female mice from influenza-induced weight loss and pulmonary pathology despite comparable early viral burdens. Transcriptomic profiling reveals increased expression of X-linked escape genes and antiviral and interferon-responsive genes, particularly in CD8+ T cells. Furthermore, Xist-deficient CD4+ and CD8+ antigen-experienced (CD44+CD11a+) T cells exhibit increased biallelic Cxcr3 expression, elevated pulmonary Cxcr3 protein levels, and enhanced IFN-{gamma} and TNF responses following ex vivo stimulation. Together, our findings reveal a previously unrecognized role for Xist RNA in regulating female antiviral T cell responses and demonstrate that enhanced T cell effector potential can accompany reduced infection-associated pulmonary injury.

papers.title: EPIC2: integrating single-cell chromatin accessibility with human genetics to identify trait-relevant cell types
papers.translated_title: EPIC2：将单细胞染色质可及性与人类遗传学整合以识别与性状相关的细胞类型
papers.author: Zhu, L.
papers.summary: Summary: EPIC2 is a computational and statistical framework for prioritizing trait-relevant cellular contexts by integrating genome-wide association study (GWAS) summary statistics with single-cell chromatin accessibility data. It accounts for linkage disequilibrium when testing for association between GWAS association strength and cell-type-specific chromatin accessibility at both SNP and regulatory-peak resolutions. The resulting P-values are combined using the Cauchy combination test. Availability and Implementation: The core workflow is implemented in R, with source code, vignettes, and reproducible test data freely available at https://github.com/LingxuanZ/EPIC2. Supplementary Information: Supplementary material accompanies this preprint.

papers.title: Bryostatin-1 exploits a developmental signaling vulnerability in MEF2D-rearranged B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia
papers.translated_title: Bryostatin-1利用MEF2D重排的B细胞前体急性淋巴细胞白血病中的发育信号脆弱性
papers.author: Glaziou, Q.
papers.summary: MEF2D-rearranged (MEF2D-r) B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia (BCP-ALL) is a rare molecular subtype associated with high-risk clinical features and frequent relapse and characterized by a distinctive pre-B-cell developmental state and dependence on pre-B-cell receptor (pre-BCR) signaling. Despite these distinctive biological features, MEF2D-r BCP-ALL lacks subtype-directed therapy. Here, we identify a pharmacologically actionable vulnerability to the diacylglycerol (DAG) mimetic bryostatin-1 (Bryo-1). Across 93 BCP-ALL cell lines, MEF2D-r models were enriched for Bryo-1 sensitivity, although responses varied within the subtype and extended to selected non-MEF2D models. Sensitive cells responded at low-nanomolar concentrations with rapid ERK activation followed by loss of pre-BCR-associated components, reduced proliferation, caspase activation and cell death. Pharmacological MEK inhibition markedly attenuated Bryo-1-induced loss of viability, supporting a functional involvement of MEK-ERK signaling. Time-resolved phosphoproteomic and proteomic analyses further revealed coordinated activation of DAG-responsive signaling and subsequent remodeling of the precursor B-cell state. Bryo-1 also altered immunotherapy-relevant surface antigens, including CD19, CD20 and CD22, as part of this broader cell-state transition. Importantly, low-nanomolar activity was reproduced ex vivo in MEF2D-r patient-derived xenograft cells. Together, these findings support pharmacological activation of a negative-selection-like developmental checkpoint as a potential therapeutic strategy in responsive MEF2D-r BCP-ALL and provide a framework for biomarker-guided functional patient selection.

papers.title: High-Resolution Spatial Transcriptomics Reveals Millimeter-Scale Malignant Territories and Immune Exclusion patterns in Human Salivary Gland Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma
papers.translated_title: 高分辨率空间转录组学揭示人涎腺腺样囊性癌中毫米级恶性区域及免疫排斥模式
papers.author: Bijukumar, G.
papers.summary: Background/Objectives: Adenoid cystic carcinoma (ACC) of the salivary gland (SGACC) is a rare malignancy with frequent late recurrence and limited response to systemic and immune therapies. Bulk and single-cell sequencing do not preserve tissue architecture, so the spatial organization of its MYB-driven myoepithelial and luminal tumor cells, stroma, and immune cells remains poorly defined. This study aimed to map the SGACC tumor microenvironment at near-cellular resolution. Methods: Visium HD based spatial transcriptomics was performed on four SGACC tissue sections from three patients with tubulo-cribriform tumor form in stage III - IV. Bins of 10 x 10 {micro}m were annotated and deconvolved with cell2location using an integrated single-cell reference of 119,189 cells from 20 donors. Pseudobulk differential expression, spatial autocorrelation, potency and spatial trajectory inference, permutation-based territory analysis, Hotspot module detection, and marker-based immune profiling were applied. Results: MYB-expressing luminal (LECs-MYB) and myoepithelial (MECs-MYB) epithelial cells occupied 55.7% of bins on average. The MECs-MYB to LECs-MYB ratio increased from the nest interior toward the tumor edge, where cancer-associated fibroblasts rose sharply. Potency and trajectory analyses placed MECs-MYB upstream of LECs-MYB. Malignant states formed territories of up to 38.0 mm2 that persisted over 1.5 mm in three sections and contained spatially restricted programs. Hypoxic stressed territories also showed mTORC1, unfolded protein response, and cell-cycle programs. T/NK, myeloid, MHC class I and II, and plasma cell signatures were 1.4- to 5.7-fold higher in stroma than in tumor nests, whereas VTCN1 (B7-H4) was the only B7 family ligand enriched within nests. Conclusions: SGACC shows an ordered arrangement of malignant lineages, millimeter-scale malignant territories, MHC class - I and II enriched stroma, and immune-excluded nests enriched for B7-H4. These features provide evidence to be validated in larger cohorts with protein-level and clinical data.

papers.title: High GPX4 Expression Marks an Oxidative-Metabolic, PD-L1/CD47-Low and Stroma-Poor Tumor State in Hepatocellular Carcinoma

papers.author: Govindaraj, P. R.
papers.summary: Background: Glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4) protects cancer cells from ferroptosis and is a candidate therapeutic target in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). How GPX4 expression relates to the immune and metabolic features of patient tumors is not well characterized. Methods: We analyzed RNA-sequencing data from 366 primary tumors of the TCGA-LIHC PanCancer Atlas cohort (365 with survival data). Associations between GPX4 and ten immune and stress-response markers were tested by Spearman correlation with Benjamini-Hochberg correction, then re-estimated after adjustment for consensus tumor purity, CTNNB1 and TP53 mutation, age and sex. A T-cell-inflamed profile, a CD8 T-cell score and an NRF2 target-gene score, gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) of GPX4-high versus GPX4-low tumors, and Cox models were added as further tests. Results: Higher GPX4 expression was associated with lower expression of PD-L1 (CD274; rho = -0.34, 95% CI -0.43 to -0.24, p = 2.4 x 10^-11), CD47 (rho = -0.21), the macrophage marker CD163 (rho = -0.17) and a fibroblast/extracellular-matrix score (rho = -0.22). These associations persisted after adjustment (CD274 rho = -0.37 in the fully adjusted model). GSEA showed enrichment of oxidative phosphorylation, mitochondrial, fatty-acid, xenobiotic and glutathione metabolism programs and depletion of extracellular-matrix, TGF-beta and cell-adhesion programs in GPX4-high tumors. GPX4 was not associated with a T-cell-inflamed profile (rho = -0.07), a CD8 T-cell score (rho = -0.03), cytolytic activity (rho = 0.04) or an NRF2 target-gene score (rho = 0.03), although NFE2L2 mRNA was inversely correlated with GPX4 (rho = -0.32). GPX4 expression was not associated with overall survival (stage-adjusted hazard ratio per SD 1.09, 95% CI 0.91-1.29). Conclusions: In TCGA-LIHC, high GPX4 expression marks a metabolically active, PD-L1/CD47-low and matrix-poor tumor state, with no evidence of T-cell exclusion, NRF2 pathway activation or prognostic value. These correlative findings come from a single cohort and require external validation and functional testing. Keywords: hepatocellular carcinoma; ferroptosis; GPX4; PD-L1; CD47; tumor microenvironment; NRF2; gene set enrichment analysis; TCGA
papers.translated_summary: 背景：谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）保护癌细胞免受铁死亡，是肝细胞癌（HCC）的候选治疗靶点。GPX4表达与患者肿瘤免疫和代谢特征的关系尚不明确。方法：我们分析了TCGA-LIHC PanCancer Atlas队列中366例原发肿瘤的RNA测序数据（365例有生存数据）。通过Spearman相关分析及Benjamini-Hochberg校正检验GPX4与十种免疫和应激反应标志物的关联，随后在调整共识肿瘤纯度、CTNNB1和TP53突变、年龄和性别后重新评估。进一步采用T细胞炎症特征、CD8 T细胞评分和NRF2靶基因评分、GPX4高表达与低表达肿瘤的基因集富集分析（GSEA）以及Cox模型作为补充检验。结果：GPX4表达较高与PD-L1（CD274；rho = -0.34，95% CI -0.43至-0.24，p = 2.4 x 10^-11）、CD47（rho = -0.21）、巨噬细胞标志物CD163（rho = -0.17）和成纤维细胞/细胞外基质评分（rho = -0.22）表达较低相关。这些关联在调整后持续存在（完全调整模型中CD274 rho = -0.37）。GSEA显示GPX4高表达肿瘤中氧化磷酸化、线粒体、脂肪酸、外源物质和谷胱甘肽代谢程序富集，而细胞外基质、TGF-beta和细胞黏附程序耗竭。GPX4与T细胞炎症特征（rho = -0.07）、CD8 T细胞评分（rho = -0.03）、细胞溶解活性（rho = 0.04）或NRF2靶基因评分（rho = 0.03）无关，尽管NFE2L2 mRNA与GPX4呈负相关（rho = -0.32）。GPX4表达与总生存期无关（分期调整后每SD风险比1.09，95% CI 0.91-1.29）。结论：在TCGA-LIHC中，GPX4高表达标志着代谢活跃、PD-L1/CD47低表达和基质贫乏的肿瘤状态，无证据表明存在T细胞排斥、NRF2通路激活或预后价值。这些相关性发现来自单一队列，需要外部验证和功能测试。关键词：肝细胞癌；铁死亡；GPX4；PD-L1；CD47；肿瘤微环境；NRF2；基因集富集分析；TCGA

papers.title: Syngeneic human iPSC Macrophages and Microglia possess distinct neuroinflammatory profiles, responses to HIV infection, and ART treatment
papers.translated_title: 同源人类iPSC巨噬细胞和小胶质细胞具有不同的神经炎症特征、对HIV感染的反应以及ART治疗反应
papers.author: Oteju, O.
papers.summary: Macrophages are innate immune cells that primarily function as professional phagocytes, playing essential roles throughout the body in host defense and maintaining homeostasis. The CNS is populated by two anatomically distinct macrophage populations; parenchymal microglia and border-resident CNS-associated macrophages (CAMs). These populations coordinate the neuroinflammatory response to pathogen-associated molecular patterns (PAMPs) through Toll-like receptor (TLR) signaling and are exposed to distinct microenvironmental cues that could shape their functions. CNS macrophages are also involved in infection with neurotropic viruses such as HIV, where the persistent infection contributes to chronic neuroinflammation and the constellation of other neurological symptoms collectively termed neuroHIV. Although antiretroviral therapy (cART) has transformed HIV care and lessened the severity of many neuroHIV symptoms, the persistence of CNS viral reservoirs and neurological deficits remains a major comorbidity and barrier to cure. Understanding specific contributions of microglia and CAMs to inflammation and neuroHIV has been challenging due to the lack of genetically matched human model systems enabling direct mechanistic comparison between of microglia and CAMs. To address this, we optimized the generation of syngeneic, human-induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) derived microglia-like (iMg) and CAM-like (iMacs) cells. These are generated simultaneously from a single donor line and have the same genetic background, enabling side-by-side characterization and functional analyses of inflammation and HIV infection. Transcriptomic profiling by RNA sequencing revealed substantial baseline differences in inflammatory and immune signaling pathways between iMg and iMacs. These intrinsic differences were also observed in TLR-specific NF-{kappa}B responses. Stimulation of TLR4 drove heightened response in iMg relative to iMac, correlating closely with morphological changes, while stimulating TLR2 had a contrasting effect, eliciting a stronger and more robust early NF-{kappa}B response in iMacs. In HIV infection studies, iMacs were more permissive to viral replication at baseline, whereas iMg showed a reduced susceptibility to infection. However, iMacs responded more robustly to cART, while iMg exhibited relative resistance to cART-mediated suppression. These findings delineate fundamental inflammatory and virologic differences between human microglia and CAMs and provide a robust foundation on which to further examine HIV infection, cART efficacy, and immune function in these distinct CNS myeloid populations.
papers.translated_summary: 巨噬细胞是固有免疫细胞，主要作为专职吞噬细胞发挥作用，在全身宿主防御和维持稳态中扮演重要角色。中枢神经系统（CNS）中存在两个解剖学上不同的巨噬细胞群体：实质小胶质细胞和边界驻留的CNS相关巨噬细胞（CAMs）。这些群体通过Toll样受体（TLR）信号协调对病原体相关分子模式（PAMPs）的神经炎症反应，并暴露于可能塑造其功能的不同微环境线索中。CNS巨噬细胞还参与嗜神经病毒如HIV的感染，其中持续性感染导致慢性神经炎症和其他一系列统称为神经HIV的神经系统症状。尽管抗逆转录病毒治疗（cART）已改变了HIV护理并减轻了许多神经HIV症状的严重程度，但CNS病毒储存库的持续存在和神经功能缺损仍然是主要的共病和治愈障碍。由于缺乏能够直接进行小胶质细胞和CAMs之间机制比较的遗传匹配人类模型系统，理解小胶质细胞和CAMs对炎症和神经HIV的具体贡献一直具有挑战性。为解决这一问题，我们优化了同基因型、人诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）来源的小胶质细胞样（iMg）和CAM样（iMacs）细胞的生成。这些细胞同时从单一供体细胞系生成，具有相同的遗传背景，使得能够并排进行炎症和HIV感染的表征及功能分析。通过RNA测序进行的转录组分析揭示了iMg和iMacs在炎症和免疫信号通路方面存在显著基线差异。这些内在差异也在TLR特异性NF-{kappa}B反应中观察到。TLR4刺激在iMg中引起比iMac更强的反应，与形态学变化密切相关，而刺激TLR2则产生相反效果，在iMacs中引发更强、更稳健的早期NF-{kappa}B反应。在HIV感染研究中，iMacs在基线时对病毒复制更为允许，而iMg显示出较低的感染易感性。然而，iMacs对cART反应更为强烈，而iMg表现出对cART介导抑制的相对抵抗。这些发现描绘了人类小胶质细胞和CAMs之间基本的炎症和病毒学差异，为进一步研究这些不同CNS髓系群体中的HIV感染、cART疗效和免疫功能提供了坚实基础。

papers.title: Media matters: A resource for understanding the determinants of migratory potential of malignant and non-malignant cells
papers.translated_title: 媒体至关重要：理解恶性和非恶性细胞迁移潜能决定因素的一种资源
papers.author: Kim, B.
papers.summary: Cell mobility is critical for homeostatic processes such as wound repair and diseases like cancer metastasis. While the advent of migrastatic and antimetastatic therapies has promise, the identification and translation of pathways important for migratory plasticity into druggable targets approved in clinical trials are considerably lacking. To better understand why, we developed an unbiased high-throughput wound-healing/invasion assay to screen for the migratory potential of >60 non-malignant and malignant cell lines derived from the pancreas, colon, skin, breast, prostate, and lung. The goal of this phenotypic screen was to provide a resource of migration/invasion potential and insight into the differential properties not only between malignant and non-malignant cells but also the various carcinomas. Surprisingly, we found non-malignant epithelial cells of the lung, skin, and pancreas migrated/invaded faster than their malignant counterparts. We observed perturbation of glucose metabolism, via inhibition of glycolysis, restricted the migration of non-malignant but not cancer cells, whereas inhibition of oxidative phosphorylation limited the mobility of malignant more than normal cells of the lung, skin, and pancreas. Short-term acclimation of cancer cells in low-nutrient media, containing low/no serum, low calcium, and physiological concentrations of glucose, increased in vitro migration/invasion and in vivo metastatic potential of lung but not pancreatic carcinomas. Phenotypic and metabolic screens presented here could identify prospective therapeutics not only for cancer metastasis, but also diseases driven by the dysregulation of wound-healing/regeneration.
papers.translated_summary: 细胞运动性对于伤口修复等稳态过程以及癌症转移等疾病至关重要。尽管迁移抑制和抗转移疗法的出现带来了希望，但将参与迁移可塑性的重要通路识别并转化为经临床试验批准的可用药靶点方面仍存在显著不足。为更好地理解其原因，我们开发了一种无偏倚的高通量伤口愈合/侵袭实验，用于筛选源自胰腺、结肠、皮肤、乳腺、前列腺和肺的60余种非恶性和恶性细胞系的迁移潜能。该表型筛选的目标是提供一份迁移/侵袭潜能的资源，并深入揭示不仅恶性与非恶性细胞之间、而且各种癌之间的差异特性。令人惊讶的是，我们发现肺、皮肤和胰腺的非恶性上皮细胞比其恶性对应细胞迁移/侵袭得更快。我们观察到，通过抑制糖酵解来扰动葡萄糖代谢，限制了非恶性细胞而非癌细胞的迁移；而抑制氧化磷酸化对肺、皮肤和胰腺恶性细胞运动性的限制大于正常细胞。癌细胞在低营养培养基（含低/无血清、低钙和生理浓度葡萄糖）中的短期适应，增加了肺腺癌而非胰腺癌的体外迁移/侵袭和体内转移潜能。本文所呈现的表型和代谢筛选不仅可为癌症转移，还可为伤口愈合/再生失调驱动的疾病识别前瞻性治疗药物。

papers.title: YAP activity sustains mitochondrial adaptation to NAMPT inhibition in triple-negative breast cancer
papers.translated_title: YAP活性维持三阴性乳腺癌中对NAMPT抑制的线粒体适应
papers.author: Buongiorno, A.
papers.summary: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) is an essential metabolic cofactor, and maintenance of NAD+ homeostasis is critical for cancer cell survival. Pharmacological inhibition of nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase (NAMPT), the rate-limiting enzyme of the NAD+ salvage pathway, induces NAD+ depletion and energetic stress, although the development of resistance limits its therapeutic potential. We have previously shown that acquired resistance to NAMPT inhibition in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) cells is associated with extensive metabolic rewiring. Here, we investigated the role of the Hippo pathway effector YAP in the cellular adaptation to NAMPT inhibition. Stable YAP downregulation markedly decreased the sensitivity of MDA-MB-231 cells to the NAMPT inhibitors FK866 and CHS-828, whereas re-expression of constitutively active YAP5SA partially restored sensitivity to FK866. YAP-silenced cells maintained NAD(H) and ATP levels during FK866 exposure and showed reduced oxidative stress and caspase 3/7 activation. Comparative proteomic analysis of YAP-silenced cells and cells with acquired FK866 resistance revealed common alterations in mitochondrial, cell-cycle, and RNA-processing programs. Consistently, YAP downregulation altered the cell-cycle response to FK866 and increased mitochondrial respiration, spare respiratory capacity, and mitochondrial mass. These findings identify YAP as a modulator of the cellular response to NAMPT inhibition and suggest that sustained YAP downregulation contributes to the establishment of an adaptive state characterized by reduced proliferative and biosynthetic programs together with increased mitochondrial capacity.
papers.translated_summary: 烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD+）是一种必需的代谢辅因子，维持NAD+稳态对癌细胞存活至关重要。药理学抑制烟酰胺磷酸核糖转移酶（NAMPT）——NAD+补救途径的限速酶——会诱导NAD+耗竭和能量应激，尽管耐药性的产生限制了其治疗潜力。我们此前已表明，三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）细胞对NAMPT抑制获得性耐药与广泛的代谢重编程相关。在此，我们研究了Hippo通路效应分子YAP在细胞适应NAMPT抑制中的作用。稳定下调YAP显著降低了MDA-MB-231细胞对NAMPT抑制剂FK866和CHS-828的敏感性，而重新表达组成性活跃的YAP5SA部分恢复了对FK866的敏感性。YAP沉默细胞在FK866暴露期间维持了NAD(H)和ATP水平，并表现出氧化应激和caspase 3/7活化减少。对YAP沉默细胞和获得性FK866耐药细胞的比较蛋白质组学分析揭示了线粒体、细胞周期和RNA加工程序的共同改变。一致地，YAP下调改变了对FK866的细胞周期反应，并增加了线粒体呼吸、备用呼吸能力和线粒体质量。这些发现表明YAP是细胞对NAMPT抑制反应的调节因子，并提示持续的YAP下调有助于建立一种适应性状态，其特征是增殖和生物合成程序减少以及线粒体能力增加。

papers.title: Metabolic priming recruits tumour cells across a mitochondrial vulnerability threshold and sensitizes them to chemotherapy
papers.translated_title: 代谢启动使肿瘤细胞跨越线粒体脆弱性阈值并使其对化疗敏感
papers.author: Iborra, F. J.
papers.summary: Intratumour heterogeneity allows a fraction of cancer cells to escape otherwise effective treatment. Here we ask whether metabolic priming can recruit heterogeneous tumour cells into a transient mitochondrial state that is selectively vulnerable to photodynamic damage. Tetramethylrhodamine methyl ester (TMRM) has previously been shown to act as a mitochondria targeted photosensitizer; we exploit its voltage-dependent accumulation and dynamic fluorescence during pulsed illumination to quantify vulnerability in single cells. The response is a reproducible fluorescence excursion, a rise to a maximum followed by a decay, accompanied by reactive oxygen species production. Comparing seventeen descriptors of this excursion against subsequent fate in 195 cells across four arms shows that quantities referenced to each cell's own resting value outperform static intensity. The simple difference Fmax F0 predicts death with held-out areas under the curve of approximately 0.75 to 0.79, whereas resting intensity alone carries little transferable information and time to peak does not discriminate fate in the datasets tested. Metabolic priming with the PKM2 activator TEPP46 or with ethyl pyruvate increases the fraction of responding cells; under TEPP46 almost the whole population enters the responding state. PKM2 abundance is associated with faster entry into that state, and PKM2 is heterogeneous in human skin tumour sections. Four hours of camptothecin shifts the response distribution, increasing the fraction of cells above the untreated median from 50% to 76%, identifying a candidate intervention window. In combination experiments, TMRM photodynamic treatment produced survival below the Bliss-independence expectation with camptothecin or TRAIL, in both treatment orders and across three cell lines; these combination measurements are descriptive and require independent replication. The study therefore identifies a perturbation-revealed mitochondrial vulnerability that can be pharmacologically recruited and followed dynamically at single-cell resolution. It is a proof of concept in cultured cells and human tumour sections and has not been tested in vivo.
papers.translated_summary: 肿瘤内异质性使一部分癌细胞能够逃避原本有效的治疗。在此，我们探讨代谢预激是否能够将异质性肿瘤细胞招募进入一种短暂的线粒体状态，该状态对光动力损伤具有选择性脆弱性。四甲基罗丹明甲酯（TMRM）此前已被证明可作为线粒体靶向光敏剂；我们利用其在脉冲光照下依赖电压的积累和动态荧光来量化单细胞的脆弱性。其响应是一种可重复的荧光偏移，即上升至最大值后衰减，并伴随活性氧的产生。将这一偏移的十七项描述指标与195个细胞在四个实验组中的后续命运进行比较，结果表明以每个细胞自身静息值为参照的量优于静态强度。简单的差值Fmax−F0预测死亡的留出曲线下面积约为0.75至0.79，而仅静息强度几乎不携带可迁移的信息，达峰时间在测试的数据集中不能区分命运。用PKM2激活剂TEPP46或丙酮酸乙酯进行代谢预激可增加响应细胞的比例；在TEPP46作用下，几乎整个细胞群体都进入响应状态。PKM2丰度与更快进入该状态相关，且PKM2在人皮肤肿瘤切片中具有异质性。四小时喜树碱处理改变了响应分布，使高于未处理中位数的细胞比例从50%增加到76%，确定了一个候选干预窗口。在联合实验中，TMRM光动力处理与喜树碱或TRAIL联合时产生的存活率低于Bliss独立模型的预期，在两种处理顺序和三种细胞系中均如此；这些联合测量为描述性结果，需要独立重复验证。因此，本研究识别出一种由扰动揭示的线粒体脆弱性，可通过药理学手段加以招募，并能在单细胞分辨率下动态追踪。这是在培养细胞和人肿瘤切片中的概念验证，尚未在体内进行测试。

papers.title: Revisiting TabGraphSyn: training boundaries and record-level conditioning in synthetic clinical data evaluation
papers.translated_title: 重新审视TabGraphSyn：合成临床数据评估中的训练边界与记录级条件
papers.author: Wu, Z.
papers.summary: Objective: To investigate how training-set contamination and record-specific conditioning affect utility estimates and membership-inference audits in synthetic clinical data generation, using TabGraphSyn as a case study. Materials and Methods: We combined implementation inspection, metric calibration, controlled changes to released synthetic tables, and train-only experiments across four cohorts containing 683 to 156,468 records. Paired retraining before and after a bundled train-only correction used three shared seeds on TCGA and ACTG 175. We assessed train-on-synthetic, test-on-real (TSTR) utility, two membership-attack families, and the decodability of record content from conditioning vectors. Results: In a contaminated MIMIC-IV output, removing synthetic records seeded by designated holdout records increased the nominal distance-attack excess from -0.0003 to 0.2248 without retraining. After the bundled train-only correction, TCGA TSTR fell by 0.0279 and the per-record GNN arm showed an additional attack signal of 4.0 resolution units relative to no conditioning. Across train-only TCGA arms, condition-to-latent decodability correlated with this signal (Spearman rho = 0.96 across ten experimental arms; exploratory); the corresponding ACTG 175 association was weaker and not statistically significant. A full-data MIA-EPT rerun detected the MIMIC-IV per-record arm after a subsampling-related sensitivity problem was addressed. Among evaluable train-only comparisons, no tested variant combined attack signals within the declared thresholds with a statistically supported utility gain over clean TabSyn. Discussion: Contamination can increase measured utility while weakening the member-versus-non-member contrast on which a privacy audit depends. Record content carried by a conditioning vector provides a separate potential disclosure channel. These mechanisms require distinct controls. Conclusion: Joint utility and privacy evaluation requires verified training boundaries, calibrated attacks and direct examination of conditioning information. Null attack results and non-significant utility differences remain limited by the tested attacks, cohorts and replication.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：以TabGraphSyn为案例，研究训练集污染和记录特定条件化如何影响合成临床数据生成中的效用估计和成员推断审计。材料与方法：我们结合了实现检查、指标校准、对已发布合成表的受控修改，以及在四个包含683至156468条记录的队列中进行的仅训练实验。在TCGA和ACTG 175上使用三个共享种子，在捆绑的仅训练校正前后进行配对再训练。我们评估了合成训练真实测试（TSTR）效用、两个成员攻击家族，以及从条件化向量中解码记录内容的可解码性。结果：在受污染的MIMIC-IV输出中，移除由指定留出记录播种的合成记录后，名义距离攻击超额从-0.0003增加到0.2248，且无需再训练。在捆绑的仅训练校正后，TCGA TSTR下降了0.0279，且逐记录GNN分支相对于无条件化显示出额外4.0个分辨率单位的攻击信号。在仅训练TCGA各分支中，条件到潜变量的可解码性与该信号相关（十个实验分支的Spearman rho = 0.96；探索性）；相应的ACTG 175关联较弱且无统计学显著性。在解决与子采样相关的敏感性问题后，全数据MIA-EPT重跑检测到了MIMIC-IV逐记录分支。在可评估的仅训练比较中，没有测试变体在声明阈值内结合攻击信号，同时相对于干净TabSyn具有统计学支持的效用增益。讨论：污染可以增加测量效用，同时削弱隐私审计所依赖的成员与非成员对比。条件化向量携带的记录内容提供了单独的潜在披露渠道。这些机制需要不同的控制措施。结论：联合效用与隐私评估需要经过验证的训练边界、校准的攻击以及对条件化信息的直接检查。零攻击结果和非显著效用差异仍受限于所测试的攻击、队列和重复。

papers.title: Renin, Major Adverse Cardiovascular Outcomes, and the Use of Mineralocorticoid Receptor Antagonists in Hypertension
papers.translated_title: 肾素、主要不良心血管结局与高血压中盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂的使用
papers.author: Tsai, C.-H.
papers.summary: Background and Aims: The prognostic significance of renin activity and its role in identifying patients who may benefit from mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs) remain incompletely defined. Methods: In a multicentre retrospective cohort of 16,600 adults with hypertension, we evaluated associations between baseline plasma renin activity and major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), comprising ischaemic stroke, intracranial haemorrhage, myocardial infarction, and all-cause death. Renin was analysed using restricted cubic splines and categories. Time-dependent Cox models assessed associations between MRA use and outcomes across renin strata, treating MRA exposure as time-varying. Results: Renin showed a U-shaped association with MACE, with the lowest estimated risk at 1.17 ng/mL/h. Compared with renin 0.3-1.0 ng/mL/h, both very low renin (<0.3 ng/mL/h; adjusted hazard ratio [HR] 1.29, 95% CI 1.15-1.45) and high renin (>3.0 ng/mL/h; HR 1.19, 1.06-1.33) were associated with higher MACE risk. MRA use was associated with lower MACE risk when renin was very low (<0.3 ng/mL/h; HR 0.59, 95% CI 0.46-0.74) or low (0.3-1.0 ng/mL/h; HR 0.71, 95% CI 0.55-0.92), whereas no significant association was observed when renin was high (>3.0 ng/mL/h; HR 1.07, 95% CI 0.76-1.52). MRA use was associated with lower all-cause mortality across renin categories [≤]3.0 ng/mL/h, whereas no significant association was observed at renin >3.0 ng/mL/h. Conclusion: Baseline renin showed a U-shaped association with MACE. The use of MRAs was associated with lower risk of MACE when renin was low and very low. These findings provide support for renin-guided MRA therapy in hypertension.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目的：肾素活性的预后意义及其在识别可能从盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂（MRAs）中获益的患者中的作用仍不完全明确。方法：在一项纳入16,600名高血压成人的多中心回顾性队列中，我们评估了基线血浆肾素活性与主要不良心血管事件（MACE）之间的关联，MACE包括缺血性卒中、颅内出血、心肌梗死和全因死亡。肾素采用限制性立方样条和分类进行分析。时间依赖Cox模型评估了MRA使用与不同肾素分层结局之间的关联，将MRA暴露视为时间变化变量。结果：肾素与MACE呈U形关联，估计风险最低点为1.17 ng/mL/h。与肾素0.3-1.0 ng/mL/h相比，极低肾素（<0.3 ng/mL/h；校正风险比[HR] 1.29，95% CI 1.15-1.45）和高肾素（>3.0 ng/mL/h；HR 1.19，1.06-1.33）均与更高的MACE风险相关。当肾素极低（<0.3 ng/mL/h；HR 0.59，95% CI 0.46-0.74）或低（0.3-1.0 ng/mL/h；HR 0.71，95% CI 0.55-0.92）时，MRA使用与较低的MACE风险相关，而当肾素高（>3.0 ng/mL/h；HR 1.07，95% CI 0.76-1.52）时未观察到显著关联。MRA使用与肾素分类≤3.0 ng/mL/h时较低的全因死亡率相关，而在肾素>3.0 ng/mL/h时未观察到显著关联。结论：基线肾素与MACE呈U形关联。当肾素低和极低时，MRA使用与较低的MACE风险相关。这些发现为高血压中肾素指导的MRA治疗提供了支持。

papers.title: HealthFound: a health world model for quantitative reasoning on longitudinal health profiles
papers.translated_title: HealthFound：用于纵向健康档案定量推理的健康世界模型
papers.author: Guo, H.
papers.summary: Medical large language models have shown promise in medical knowledge retrieval and clinical reasoning but remain limited in quantitative reasoning over longitudinal health data, partly due to the lack of effective data construction and model training strategies tailored to large-scale prospective cohorts. Here, we present HealthFound, a health world model trained on 12.4 million constructed examples, including 14-year longitudinal biomedical records from 501,936 participants and datasets for medical knowledge and general reasoning. We propose a three-stage training framework comprising progressive curriculum supervised fine-tuning, rejection-sampled retention fine-tuning, and task-verifiable policy optimization. This enables the model to effectively parse heterogeneous quantitative data and perform robust quantitative reasoning about incident diseases and health trajectories. HealthFound achieves the highest mean accuracy across eight public medical benchmarks. On the task of predicting 1,074 future disease onsets, it outperforms the closest large language model by approximately 10 percentage points on average. In two independent external validations (MIMIC-IV and NHANES), it demonstrates superior zero-shot generalization, achieving improvements of over 5.2% across 417 disease endpoints. The model also achieves top results on tasks involving literature-derived question answering and quantitative indicator imputation. Furthermore, HealthFound generates interpretable reasoning rationales that are consistent with established biomedical knowledge. Collectively, our results demonstrate that HealthFound enables medical LLMs to evolve from static knowledge repositories into dynamic quantitative reasoning engines over longitudinal health data.
papers.translated_summary: 医学大语言模型在医学知识检索和临床推理方面已展现出前景，但在纵向健康数据的定量推理方面仍然有限，部分原因在于缺乏针对大规模前瞻性队列的有效数据构建和模型训练策略。在此，我们提出HealthFound，一个健康世界模型，基于1240万个构建样本训练而成，包括来自501936名参与者的14年纵向生物医学记录，以及医学知识和通用推理数据集。我们提出了一个三阶段训练框架，包括渐进式课程监督微调、拒绝采样保留微调以及任务可验证策略优化。这使模型能够有效解析异构定量数据，并对发病疾病和健康轨迹进行稳健的定量推理。HealthFound在八个公开医学基准上取得了最高的平均准确率。在预测1074种未来疾病发病的任务上，其平均表现比最接近的大语言模型高出约10个百分点。在两项独立外部验证（MIMIC-IV和NHANES）中，它展现出优越的零样本泛化能力，在417个疾病终点上实现了超过5.2%的提升。该模型在涉及文献衍生问答和定量指标插补的任务上也取得了最佳结果。此外，HealthFound生成的可解释推理依据与已建立的生物医学知识相一致。总体而言，我们的结果表明，HealthFound使医学大语言模型能够从静态知识库演变为面向纵向健康数据的动态定量推理引擎。

papers.title: AI chatbots abandon sleep apnoea referral when simulated patients minimise symptoms
papers.translated_title: AI聊天机器人在模拟患者淡化症状时放弃睡眠呼吸暂停转诊
papers.author: Ratneswaran, D.
papers.summary: Background: Patients increasingly consult free artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots about their symptoms, but these models may favour agreement with the patient over accuracy. In obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA), where most cases in the general population remain undiagnosed and diagnosis depends on referral, this could validate symptom denial. We tested whether consumer chatbots maintain guideline-concordant referral when a simulated patient minimises symptoms. Methods: Seven guideline-concordant and standardised OSA vignettes (apnoea-hypopnoea-index, AHI 18-52 events/h; body mass index 28-42 kg/m2) were presented to five free chatbots (GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek V4 Flash and Grok-4.3) under neutral and symptom-minimising conditions (10 simulated conversations per model-vignette-condition cell; N=700). Referral maintenance was scored by a structured rubric and every capitulation was human-confirmed. Results: All chatbots maintained referral recommendations in neutral conversations (350/350; 100%). When simulated patients minimised symptoms and resisted referral, maintenance fell to 64.3% (225/350), a reduction of 35.7 percentage points (95% CI 5.5-66.0; p=0.028). Rates ranged from 55.7% to 85.7% across chatbots, but evidence of between-chatbot differences was inconsistent across analyses. Rates differed across clinical vignettes (p=0.001). A variance analysis estimated greater variation between vignettes than between chatbots. In the three driving-risk vignettes, referral recommendations were abandoned in 46-68% of symptom-minimising conversations, pooling all five chatbots within each vignette. Conclusions: Consumer AI chatbots abandoned correct OSA referral recommendations in about one-third of symptom-minimising conversations, with higher observed abandonment in simulated cases involving driving risk. This may delay appropriate assessment and raises patient- and public-safety concerns.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：患者越来越多地就自身症状咨询免费的人工智能（AI）聊天机器人，但这些模型可能更倾向于迎合患者而非保证准确性。在阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）中，普通人群中大多数病例仍未得到诊断，且诊断依赖于转诊，因此这种情况可能使否认症状得到认可。我们测试了当模拟患者尽量淡化症状时，消费级聊天机器人是否能维持与指南一致的转诊建议。方法：将七个与指南一致且标准化的OSA案例（呼吸暂停-低通气指数，AHI 18-52次/小时；体重指数28-42 kg/m2）呈现给五个免费聊天机器人（GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6、DeepSeek V4 Flash和Grok-4.3），分别在中性条件和症状淡化条件下进行测试（每个模型-案例-条件单元10次模拟对话；N=700）。转诊维持情况通过结构化评分标准进行评分，每一次让步均经人工确认。结果：所有聊天机器人在中性对话中均维持了转诊建议（350/350；100%）。当模拟患者淡化症状并抗拒转诊时，维持率降至64.3%（225/350），下降了35.7个百分点（95% CI 5.5-66.0；p=0.028）。各聊天机器人的维持率范围为55.7%至85.7%，但聊天机器人之间存在差异的证据在各分析中不一致。不同临床案例之间的维持率存在差异（p=0.001）。方差分析估计，案例之间的变异大于聊天机器人之间的变异。在三个涉及驾驶风险的案例中，将所有五个聊天机器人在每个案例内合并计算，症状淡化对话中有46-68%放弃了转诊建议。结论：消费级AI聊天机器人在约三分之一的症状淡化对话中放弃了正确的OSA转诊建议，在涉及驾驶风险的模拟案例中观察到的放弃率更高。这可能延误适当的评估，并引发患者和公共安全方面的担忧。

papers.title: FHIRTrustBench: An Open Benchmark for Evaluating FHIR-Integrated Clinical AI
papers.translated_title: FHIRTrustBench：用于评估FHIR集成临床AI的开放基准
papers.author: Hayder, N. S.
papers.summary: Hospitals now use AI models to support clinical decisions. Increasingly, these models read patient data from electronic health records through FHIR, the standard format for exchanging health data. Before the data reach the model, they are converted: codes are mapped, units are normalised and records become model inputs. This conversion is rebuilt at every hospital, and when it fails, for example when a lab value arrives in an unexpected unit, the model still accepts the input and returns a score, and the error can pass unnoticed. Existing reporting guidelines ask authors to describe how input data were prepared and checked, but not in terms specific enough to verify a FHIR pipeline. Here we introduce FHIRTrustBench, an open benchmark that assesses what published FHIR-based AI systems demonstrate, from patient record to clinician. It defines 46 criteria in five dimensions, each grounded in published work. One dimension, FHIR specificity, also serves as a provisional gate: a proposed reporting threshold that combines two mandatory items with a minimum score. Two coders independently applied the benchmark to 16 published systems and agreed closely (weighted {kappa} = 0.80). Nearly all stated where their data came from, but none fully described how FHIR data became model inputs, and no deployed system reported monitoring its inputs for change. No system passed the gate. This does not mean the systems are unsafe; it means their published evidence cannot show whether they are safe. Because FHIR already provides tools to check each step, much of this gap can be closed by reporting what was done. We release the benchmark, code and coded evidence for reuse.
papers.translated_summary: 医院现在使用AI模型支持临床决策。越来越多的此类模型通过FHIR（交换健康数据的标准格式）从电子健康记录中读取患者数据。在数据到达模型之前，它们会被转换：代码被映射、单位被归一化，记录成为模型输入。这种转换在每家医院都要重新构建，而当转换失败时——例如当某个实验室数值以意外的单位到达时——模型仍然接受输入并返回一个评分，错误可能不被察觉。现有的报告指南要求作者描述输入数据是如何准备和检查的，但没有具体到足以验证FHIR管道的程度。在此我们推出FHIRTrustBench，这是一个开放式基准，用于评估已发表的基于FHIR的AI系统从患者记录到临床医生这一过程中展示了什么。它定义了五个维度下的46项标准，每项标准都以已发表的研究为依据。其中一个维度——FHIR特异性——还充当临时门槛：一个拟议的报告阈值，将两个必填项与最低分数相结合。两名编码员独立地将该基准应用于16个已发表系统，并达成高度一致（加权{kappa}=0.80）。几乎所有系统都说明了其数据来源，但没有一个系统完整描述了FHIR数据如何成为模型输入，也没有任何已部署系统报告对其输入进行变化监测。没有系统通过该门槛。这并不意味着这些系统不安全；这意味着它们已发表的证据无法表明它们是否安全。由于FHIR已经提供了检查每个步骤的工具，这一差距的很大一部分可以通过报告所做的事情来弥合。我们发布该基准、代码和编码证据以供复用。

papers.title: SynTrustBench: Benchmarking Synthetic Clinical Data with Calibrated False-Positive Rates and Certified Limits of Detection
papers.translated_title: SynTrustBench：以校准假阳性率和经认证检测限为基准的合成临床数据基准测试
papers.author: Hayder, N. S.
papers.summary: Medical research requires large volumes of patient data. Such data are difficult to obtain because of strict privacy regulations. Artificially generated data (synthetic data) promise to share data safely, thereby bypassing any need to go through strict, time-consuming regulations. To test this promise, benchmarks have been developed to evaluate synthetic data on their safety and usefulness. However, the benchmarks themselves are rarely evaluated. We propose SynTrustBench, an executable framework for evaluating the fidelity, utility and privacy of synthetic clinical data. Unlike existing benchmarks, SynTrustBench does not assume its metrics are valid before testing them. For each dimension it evaluates, SynTrustBench estimates two properties. Its false-positive rate is controlled by setting the pass/fail threshold at the 95th percentile of the null distribution from 100 real-versus-real comparisons, so real data of the calibration size fail at most 5% of the time. Its limit of detection is estimated by injecting failures of known type and size, such as copied training records, at graded doses into real data; it is the smallest dose detected with at least 95% probability, certified at 95% confidence. Every SynTrustBench verdict therefore carries a confidence statement. On two public diabetes datasets, real data failed in 2.8% and 3.2% of real-versus-real comparisons, within the 5% bound, and every certified limit of detection held on fresh data. SynTrustBench detected as few as 3 copied training records among 11,443, and, in an exploratory application to real generators, it flagged a privacy-relevant proximity anomaly in a TVAE generator on every seed that a standard membership-inference attack did not register (AUC 0.50). Against SDMetrics under the same calibration, it matched or exceeded the privacy metric on one dataset but not the other, and was more sensitive on fidelity.
papers.translated_summary: 医学研究需要大量患者数据。由于严格的隐私法规，此类数据难以获取。人工生成的数据（合成数据）有望实现数据的安全共享，从而绕过任何需要通过严格且耗时的法规的需求。为检验这一前景，人们已开发出基准来评估合成数据的安全性和实用性。然而，这些基准本身很少受到评估。我们提出 SynTrustBench，一个用于评估合成临床数据的保真度、实用性和隐私性的可执行框架。与现有基准不同，SynTrustBench 在测试其指标之前并不假定这些指标是有效的。对于它所评估的每个维度，SynTrustBench 估计两个属性。其假阳性率通过将通过/失败阈值设定为 100 次真实对真实比较所得零分布的第 95 百分位数来控制，因此校准规模的真实数据最多只有 5% 的概率失败。其检测限通过将已知类型和规模的失败（例如复制的训练记录）按递增剂量注入真实数据来估计；它是以至少 95% 概率检测到的最小剂量，并以 95% 置信度予以认证。因此，每个 SynTrustBench 判定都附带置信声明。在两个公开糖尿病数据集上，真实数据在真实对真实比较中的失败率分别为 2.8% 和 3.2%，处于 5% 界限之内，且每个经认证的检测限在新数据上均成立。SynTrustBench 在 11,443 条记录中检测出仅 3 条复制的训练记录，并且在对真实生成器的探索性应用中，它在 TVAE 生成器的每个种子上都标记出一个与隐私相关的邻近异常，而标准成员推断攻击未能检测到该异常（AUC 0.50）。在相同校准下与 SDMetrics 相比，它在一个数据集上的隐私指标达到或超过后者，但在另一个数据集上未达到，且在保真度上更为敏感。
